coverage.description: Logical source region "fn terminal(" through before "/// Cut out". For n tokens, Q is an ordered sequence [a_i,b_i), a_0=0, b_last=n, b_i=a_next and a_i<b_i; n=0 gives Q empty. Oracle exhausts the six-symbol alphabet through length four independently via flattened coverage. After a terminal run extended over closers/terminals, suppress the break iff the next first Unicode character is lowercase or one of comma/semicolon/colon/hyphen/en-dash/em-dash. EOF forces the run end; empty next token does not continue. Oracle includes accented cases and punctuation. Terminal is nonempty and every character belongs to . ! ? …; closer is an exact token from the fixed eight-string set. Mixed '.x' and '(' do not qualify. This is a token-level rule, not general linguistic punctuation. Parent composition retains shared text/clock/intermediate values. Full-file wrapper and test gaps remain in the root.
